svg.aria-label: HARPY data model. Agents emit messages that carry claims; lineage edges link parent and child claims. An audit reads an agent's window and names an evidence claim; attribution walks lineage back to the origin agent and credits suspicion there; suspicion past the gate triggers isolation. Ground truth fields are readable only by scoring code. A ledger charges every oversight cost against worker spend.
